display_name: Denver Metro & Rocky Mountain Hub, CO

econometric_drivers.title: Isolated High-Altitude Refining Island & DJ Basin Dynamics
econometric_drivers.description: PADD 4 is physically isolated by the Rocky Mountains with virtually zero refined product pipeline ingress from the Gulf Coast or Midwest. Regional supply is dominated by local refining complexes (Suncor Commerce City 103 kbpd and Salt Lake City refineries), with localized crack spreads tied to Denver Julesburg (DJ) Basin sweet crude and Wyoming sour blends.

refining_logistics.title: Suncor Commerce City Refining Island & Midstream Corridors
refining_logistics.description: Supply is anchored by the Suncor Commerce City Refinery (103 kbpd), the sole major refinery in Colorado producing ~35-40% of Colorado refined products. Supplementary supply moves via Magellan Pipeline from Kansas/PADD 2, Sinclair Pipeline from Wyoming, and waterborne/rail shipments into Front Range terminals.

tax_structure.title: Colorado Statutory Motor Fuel Excise Tax Burden
tax_structure.description: Colorado state motor fuel excise tax ($0.280/gal statutory fixed rate, no local sales tax on motor fuel) plus Federal excise tax ($0.184/gal) establish a statutory baseline tax burden of $0.464/gal.
tax_structure.notes: Statutory baseline excise tax of $0.464/gal with Front Range ozone nonattainment reformulated summer requirements

infrastructure_delivery.title: Denver Rack Differential & Front Range High-Altitude Dynamics
infrastructure_delivery.equation_latex: \text{Rack Margin}_{\text{Denver}} = P_{\text{Denver Retail}} - P_{\text{Denver Wholesale Rack}} = \$3.150 - \$2.300 = \$0.850/\text{gal}
infrastructure_delivery.description: Denver wholesale rack prices trade at a basis differential to NYMEX RBOB and Cushing WTI, influenced by high-altitude seasonal vapor pressure transitions and EPA Front Range ozone nonattainment blend requirements.

shock_scenarios.description: Severe Arctic freeze knocks out Commerce City CDU and FCC units, cutting ~100 kbpd regional supply and forcing expensive long-distance rail/truck fuel imports from Midcontinent

shock_scenarios.description: Annual switch to low-volatility summer blend in 9-county Front Range ozone nonattainment area raises local refinery blending costs
